name.value: Christina Lake Motel and RV Park

description.value: A private, year-round motel-and-RV park in the Christina Lake village with 7 tent sites, on-site showers, and a short walk to the lake; facilities skew toward RV guests and no tent pricing is published.

address.value: 19 West Lake Drive, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E2

raw_osm.name: Christina Lake Motel and RV Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a combined motel and RV park with 48 RV sites, 7 tenting sites, and motel rooms at 19 West Lake Drive in Christina Lake, BC. Showers are explicitly listed as 'Free On Site Showers' on the RV park page. Reservations are confirmed by multiple 'Book Now' buttons and the statement 'Book Online below or Call Us for details.' Food nearby is supported by the gallery referencing 'The Fork In The Road Food Bus' and a 'Food' navigation menu item. No explicit mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, cyclist discounts, or bike-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website provides 236-350-0013
OSM tags are minimal (no amenity detail); most amenity data derived from website only
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A campground with tenting sites, showers, and proximity to biking trails on a well-known BC cycling corridor makes this a practical stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: 7 tenting sites, Free On Site Showers — no cyclist-specific provision
